name: Ryoujoku Chikan Densha ~Chikan Sen'you Sharyou ni Youkoso~
original_name: 陵辱痴漢電車  ~チカン専用車両にようこそ~
source:
One day, a high school girl suddenly ends being forced to let herself be groped in public on a train, to pay off her father's debt. What will become of her?
